method: Fake-Provider-driven, deterministic-pipeline tests through the SAME unchanged validate_shadow_bundle / comqutor.structured_claim_shadow.v1 schema used by v1. These prove the v2 wire-format reduction preserves every canonical bundle capability v1 had; they do not and cannot prove real-model semantic quality (SEMANTIC_QUALITY remains UNPROVEN, unchanged, pending human review under WAITING_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW).

concepts_covered: single claim (one candidate to one claim)
split (one source region into two claims)
merge (two source spans into one claim, evidence = bounded join)
negation (preserved wording, not flipped)
hypothetical/question (abstention, not assertion)
quoted attribution (preserved wording)
temporal qualification (preserved wording)
uncertainty (confidence + hedging wording preserved)
multiple evidence spans (both validated)
factor vocabulary enforcement (in-vocabulary accepted, out-of-vocabulary rejected)
direction enum enforcement (invalid value rejected)
entity grounding enforcement (ungrounded entity rejected)
claim outside any candidate hint (model not restricted to the located-hint subset)
candidate lineage resolution (short int id -> full candidate_segment_id)
identity fields always caller-owned (never required from, or trusted from, the Provider)
full parser round trip (prompt build -> Fake Provider -> JSON parse -> normalize -> validate)
exact_quote reconstructed from offsets alone (Provider never sends quote text)
unicode and emoji offsets
newline and punctuation offsets
overlapping spans across claims recorded as a diagnostic warning, not an error (unchanged v1 behavior)
non-int offset type rejected, not crashed
negative offset rejected
out-of-range end offset rejected
inverted (end<=start) offset rejected
missing span keys rejected, not crashed (no KeyError)
span not an object rejected, not crashed
empty spans list rejected, not silently accepted
tests/structured_output_shadow/test_shad.explicit_non_repair_proof: No case fuzzy-matches or auto-corrects an invalid span; every invalid case is rejected by the unchanged validate_shadow_bundle and, at the full-parser level, produces an empty claims list.

concepts_covered: report text structurally labeled by its own JSON key, fixed instruction precedes the entire JSON payload
proposal top-level identity fields (schema_version/run_id/production_authority) ignored, never trusted
claim-level unapproved fields (shadow_claim_id, production_authority, shadow_only) cannot flip authority -- final claim key set is exactly CLAIM_FIELDS
invented/out-of-range span asserting fabricated content rejected
credential-like report text rejected even though v2 never asks the model to copy evidence text (evidence is deterministically reconstructed, and still runs through the same _CREDENTIAL_RE filter)
schema_version cannot be changed regardless of report or proposal content
full parser pipeline never leaks injected report content into identity fields
real v2 request for the frozen NVDA fundamental report is <= 40,000 chars
report duplication ratio is at the 1.0 target (report sent exactly once, no claim_hint/evidence_hint text anywhere)
v2 request construction is deterministic (byte-identical across two independent builds)
v1 baseline (98,633 chars) still reproduces from the real production code -- pins the audit against silent drift
v2 is a >=50% reduction from v1 (actual measured: 80.86%)

totals.full_structured_output_shadow_suite_stat: 173 passed (includes the 39 new v2 tests plus all pre-existing v1/Phase-1-Master tests, unmodified and still passing)

canonical_schema_and_validator.note: Every v2 test exercises the identical, unmodified validate_shadow_bundle function v1 uses. No v2-specific validation branch or relaxed check was added anywhere.
